text:
Priya: quick pulse — I kicked off the quant/priming microexp last night. Need a tiny cost-quality summary for GTN.
Leo: got the runs. pushed results to S3: s3://redwood-experiments/3198765432. TL;DR below.
Anika: TL;DR please (per-100k tokens, p95, and where quality regressed).
Leo: baseline = llama-like-13b-int8 (prod). experiment = zephyr9b-int4 + priming light (+5% tokens).
```
baseline per-100k = $9.40, p95 = 340ms, longform F1 = 0.901
zephyr9b-int4 per-100k = $4.85, p95 = 360ms, longform F1 = 0.889
priming overhead = +5% tokens, search recall +1.8%
```
Victor: that's ~48% cost cut before rerank cost. If we add a cheap rerank (2% traffic) net savings ~44%.
Priya: where's the quality hit located? hallucinations, factuality, or structure?
Leo: mostly structure/coherence on >600-token summaries; factual recall on multi-sentence facts is slightly lower. QA/extraction OK.
Anika: product requires <0.012 absolute drop on longform F1. Can routing plus a tiny rerank recover that?
Leo: sim policy: route by length + confidence; rerank only low-confidence outputs -> brings F1 within 0.007 of baseline, cost savings ~40% net.
Priya: propose rollout plan for GTN: flag `quant.zephyr9b.v1` with steps 2% -> 10% -> 30%, sample 0.15% to human eval. rollback if longform_F1_drop > 0.012 or regen_rate > 1.6x.
Victor: add A/B arm to test priming intensity (5% vs 9%) to measure recall/token efficiency.
Anika: please paste the routing snippet so ops can copy.
Leo: snippet:
{ "flag":"quant.zephyr9b.v1", "routing":[ {"max_len":250,"primary":"zephyr9b-int4","fallback":"llama13b-int8","weight_primary":0.85}, {"min_len":251,"max_len":600,"primary":"zephyr9b-int4","fallback":"llama13b-int8","weight_primary":0.65}, {"min_len":601,"primary":"llama13b-int8","fallback":"zephyr9b-int4","weight_primary":1.0} ], "priming":{"extra_tokens_pct":5}, "rerank_flow":"llama-lite-rerank" }
Priya: good. include a cheap signal: log `struct_coherence` and `fact_recall` per-route. GTN wants dashboards per-endpoint.
Victor: I'll add those metrics. ops: can you schedule the 2% canary tomorrow?
deploy-bot: scheduled: feature flag quant.zephyr9b.v1 -> 2% at 3198765400, healthchecks enabled.
Anika: one more micro-experiment ask: run a small fold with zephyr9b-int6 (int6 quant) for a 24h compare; might have better coherence at slightly higher cost.
Leo: queued. I'll push int6 run and compare slices; will report delta on the same s3 path by EOD.
Priya: perfect. aim to have PR + one-pager for GTN with per-endpoint amortized savings by tomorrow morning.
Victor: noted. closing loop here.
Anika: thanks folks :thumbsup:
